site: Example Panda Gazebo simulation site (test data only)
notes: Example only, not a statement about any Panda arm. The clone's arm joint limits live in the franka_ros submodule, which is not in the pinned top-level commit, and the action timeout 0 waits indefinitely. Replace every value with the reviewed range of the deployed cell. Until site-limits.json supplies them, calls carrying these fields are refused with MHS.SAFETY.LIMITS_UNSET.

points[*].positions.reason: example joint travel envelope for the test harness; the deployed site supplies its own per-joint bounds

time_axis_step.reason: example automatic time-axis step envelope for the test harness; the deployed site supplies its own timing

timeout_s.reason: example bounded execution timeout for the test harness; the deployed site supplies its own stop-aware bound
